title: Glimpse of Japan Short Group Tour
alt: Neon lanes of Shinjuku after dark, Tokyo
transport: Bullet train, coaches and guided touring throughout

activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Five days, three cities and four star hotels. If you only have a week of leave, this is the Japan trip that fits.
expert.tip: The guided Shinjuku walk on the first evening is the trick that beats the jet lag. Eat late, sleep well, start fresh.

summary: Five days through three cities on a small group tour: two nights beside Shinagawa with a guided Shinjuku evening and a full Tokyo day, a night in a Kyoto garden hotel with its temples, then Nara and a last night in central Osaka.
included: Included: 4 nights in four star hotels; bullet train from Tokyo to Kyoto and coaches throughout; private airport transfers; guided Shinjuku district tour; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Kyoto sightseeing tour; Nara sightseeing tour; breakfast on the last two mornings.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; most meals; travel insurance; personal expenses.
